profile.summary: Ghost is a specialized JavaScript developer with deep expertise in date/time libraries, particularly Moment.js. Their contributions focus on internationalization, performance optimization, and precise locale-specific formatting. The developer demonstrates strong skills in debugging, cultural sensitivity, and technical precision, with a niche but impactful impact on date handling in JavaScript ecosystems. Their work is primarily confined to backend/library-level JavaScript, with no evidence of frontend frameworks or broader ecosystem contributions.
